script_text: Here's a shocker for an Earth sign: Saturn enters your 2nd House of Money, Taurus, and it's demanding serious financial honesty this week. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury squares Uranus in your 2nd House, sparking unpredictable budget disruptions and workplace confusion — Monday is the roughest. The Sun travels through your 6th House of Health, so overwork exhaustion is very real. The turning point arrives Wednesday when Venus, your ruling planet, enters your 7th House of Partnership — a heartfelt conversation could genuinely transform a relationship. Thursday forward, Mars trines Jupiter through your 4th and 5th Houses, filling home and creativity with warmth. The weekend is restorative; social magic peaks Sunday. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House drawing love and diplomacy. Monday is worst because Mercury square Uranus destabilizes your finances. Open that avoided bank statement before Friday. Follow for daily updates.
